reviews.body: Edited: Coming from Butterflies AI, I had hope for this app, but as usual, there's too much behind a paywall & free does so little. I understand that there are costs, but I don't feel it's fair to create a character and not even be able to have them post even once without paying. There ISN'T a way to edit a created character, users besides me put this in the app requests. The mechanics & Instagram look are nice, but it's not enough to subscribe for. Butterflies AI clearly spoiled me.
reviews.author: Couch Pirate
reviews.reply: Edited: You are totally right, there was a bug preventing AI updates on Android. I'm so sorry! This has been fixed now so you should be able to edit any character you make. And I agree on costs, but I just can't yet afford to give more away for free. Thank you for your feedback!
